findings.title: Service image uses :latest tag
findings.description: Pinning :latest (or omitting the tag) makes deploys non-reproducible and can silently pull a new, vulnerable image. Pin an explicit version tag or digest.
findings.expected: pinned version tag (e.g. nginx:1.25.3) or digest
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Docker and CIS Docker Benchmark best practices. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, least privilege, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
